newsitem.title: USA: Applied Innovation sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Applied Innovation sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Applied Innovation Inc said on Wednesday it expects a fourth quarter loss up to $1.1 million, or $0.07 a share, after its margins were hurt by warranty costs.
Applied Innovation's total fourth quarter revenue is expected to be approximately $9.9 million, an increase of 12 percent compared with the same period a year ago.
In 1995's fourth quarter, the company reported profits of $900,000, or $0.06 a share.
Applied Innovation said 1996 total revenue is anticipated to be approximately $41.1 million versus $36.0 million in last year.
For the twelve months ended December 31, 1996, the company expects net income of approximately $2.0 million, or $0.13 per share, versus $6.1 million, or $0.38 per share, in 1995.
The company expects to report its full year earnings by February 28, 1997, it said.
Applied Innovation said it has started shipping new products in December 1996 and that its sales for 1997 are expected to show solid growth over 1996 levels.
